title: Core Set 2021 Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Chandra Nalaar calls a know-it-all show-off.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who teases Teferi for showing off his knowledge.

entities.name: Braids, Dementia Summoner
entities.description: A dementia summoner who mocks talk of lost sanity.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who vows to protect the weak from the strong.

entities.name: House of Vess
entities.description: A noble house whose purple banner is a symbol of death.

entities.name: The Molten Prophecy
entities.description: An in-world writing prophesying that the mountain's fire will end an age of oppression.

entities.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
entities.description: A wanderer who calls Kamigawa her home and its people her family, rather than Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A forest that Azusa says is not her home.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane Azusa calls her home.

entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: A creature through whose eyes a shaman saw everything else as prey.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: A peaceful rest that does not come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

entities.name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
entities.description: A Tolarian archmage who says one never stops learning.

entities.name: Kaervek, the Spiteful
entities.description: A spiteful figure who threatens those who defy or betray him.

entities.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
entities.description: A figure who preaches redemption through the blood of the wicked.

entities.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
entities.description: A recluse who declares humans unwelcome in her forest.

relations.quote: My home is Kamigawa, its people my family.
But do you have to be such a show-off about it?
